sources.note: Recasts long-document visual question answering as building an explicit evidence graph whose nodes are grounded document blocks and whose edges are reasoning dependencies, and verifies the graph causally — masking the evidence it cites flips 82.8% of correct answers while masking uncited evidence changes 9.6%.
sources.title: DocTrace: Towards Traceable Long Document VQA via Hierarchical Evidence Graph Reasoning

sources.note: Argues that faithfulness alone is insufficient for CoT monitoring and adds verbosity — whether the trace lists every factor needed to solve the task — combining the two into a monitorability score, then shows models can look faithful while omitting key factors.
sources.title: Measuring Chain-of-Thought Monitorability Through Faithfulness and Verbosity

instructions:

`related` is the one part of the note nothing can work out on its own.
